english: An ornate book lays open on Juniper's desk...

russian: На столе Джунипер раскрыта изысканно украшенная книга...
bulgarian: An ornate book lays open on Juniper's desk...

english: Jars full of colorful concoctions fill the shelf.

russian: На полках расставлены банки с разноцветными отварами.

english: Cubbies for bathers to store their clothing in.

english: This doorway leads to the bath, but you need to pay at the front desk before you can go in.
french: Ce passage mène au bain, mais vous devez payer au comptoir d'accueil avant d'y accéder.

english: The fountain gives the changing room a feeling of serenity.

russian: Фонтан создаёт в раздевалке атмосферу спокойствия.

french: Des savons faits maison et des bocaux s'alignent sur les étagères.

english: You're not sure what the crystal has to do with bathing.
french: Vous ne voyez pas bien le rapport entre ce cristal et les bains.
russian: Не очень понятно, как кристалл связан с купанием.
bulgarian: You're not sure what the crystal has to do with bathing.

english: Bath salts, bath oils, and a very big crystal.
french: Des sels de bain, des huiles et un très gros cristal.
russian: Различные соли и масла для ванн, а также очень большой кристалл.

bulgarian: Interestingly, they don't seem to be bath products.

english: Many of these jars and boxes are unlabeled.

russian: Многие банки и коробки не подписаны.
bulgarian: Many of these jars and boxes are unlabeled.

english: The door is locked.
french: La porte est fermée à clé.
russian: Эта дверь заперта.
bulgarian: The door is locked.

english: Display tools are lined up for sale.
french: Des outils de démonstration sont exposés pour la vente.
russian: На витрине выставлены инструменты на продажу.
bulgarian: Display tools are lined up for sale.

english: A carefully tended house plant.
french: Plante d'intérieur soignée avec attention.
russian: За этим растением хорошо ухаживают.
bulgarian: A carefully tended house plant.

english: An impressive collection of trophies and awards fill March's shelves.
french: Une impressionnante collection de trophées et de récompenses orne les étagères de March.
russian: Полки занимает впечатляющая коллекция трофеев и наград Марта.
bulgarian: An impressive collection of trophies and awards fill March's shelves.

english: It smells nice, like cedarwood and sage.

russian: От него приятно пахнет кедром и шалфеем.
bulgarian: It smells nice, like cedarwood and sage.

english: A wooden clothing trunk.
french: Coffre à vêtements en bois.
russian: Деревянный платяной сундук.
bulgarian: A wooden clothing trunk.

english: This must be Olric's collection of interesting crystals and minerals.
french: Ce doit être la collection de cristaux et de minerais remarquables d'Olric.
russian: Судя по всему, это коллекция занимательных кристаллов и минералов Ольрика.
bulgarian: This must be Olric's collection of interesting crystals and minerals.

english: A shelf lined with small geological treasures.
french: Étagère où s'alignent les petites trouvailles géologiques.
russian: Шкаф заставлен небольшими геологическими находками.
bulgarian: A shelf lined with small geological treasures.

english: A variety of strange looking rocks decorate this shelf.
french: Différentes roches d'apparence inhabituelle décorent l'étagère.
russian: В этом шкафу лежат разные странные камни.
bulgarian: A variety of strange looking rocks decorate this shelf.

english: This work bench is scrupulously organized.
french: Cet établi est méticuleusement organisé.
russian: Рабочий стол выглядит скрупулёзно упорядоченным.
bulgarian: This work bench is scrupulously organized.

english: It seems someone placed them here a long time ago...
french: On dirait que quelqu'un les a placées là il y a très longtemps.
russian: Видимо, давным-давно кто-то их так положил.

english: A small pile of moss-covered stones.

russian: Небольшая груда камней, поросших мхом.
bulgarian: A small pile of moss-covered stones.

english: Despite the chest's age, it still smells pleasantly of sandalwood - soothing and warm.
french: Malgré son ancienneté, le coffre dégage toujours une agréable odeur de bois de santal, apaisante et réconfortante.

bulgarian: Despite the chest's age, it still smells pleasantly of sandalwood - soothing and warm.

english: A clothing chest sits below shelves overflowing with ancient scrolls.
french: Un coffre à vêtements est installé sous des étagères débordant de parchemins anciens.
russian: Под полками, забитыми древними свитками, стоит платяной сундук.
bulgarian: A clothing chest sits below shelves overflowing with ancient scrolls.

english: Unfortunately, you can't read a word of it...
french: Malheureusement, vous n'arrivez pas à déchiffrer un seul mot...
russian: К сожалению, вы не можете прочитать ни слова...
bulgarian: Unfortunately, you can't read a word of it...

english: An old scroll lays open on the desk.

russian: На столе лежит раскрытый свиток.
bulgarian: An old scroll lays open on the desk.

french: Un vieux parchemin est ouvert sur le bureau. On y voit les flux d'énergie magique souterrains.
russian: На столе лежит раскрытый старинный свиток. В нём описаны подробные инструкции по направлению магических потоков в подземных условиях.
bulgarian: An old scroll lays open on the desk. It details the channeling of magical energy in subterranean environments.

english: The sunken hearth gives the room a cozy ambience.
french: L'âtre enterré donne à la pièce une atmosphère confortable.

bulgarian: The sunken hearth gives the room a cozy ambience.

french: Ils semblent bien conservés.
russian: С виду они хорошо сохранились.
bulgarian: They appear to be well-preserved.

russian: Полки за занавеской набиты древними свитками.
bulgarian: Ancient scrolls fill the shelves behind the curtain.

english: A collection of cute bird houses handmade by Ryis.
french: Collection de jolis nichoirs fabriqués par Ryis.
russian: Коллекция милых скворечников, которые сделал Риз.
bulgarian: A collection of cute bird houses handmade by Ryis.

french: Divers ouvrages de charpenterie et des guides ornithologiques emplissent les étagères.

bulgarian: A variety of carpentry books and birdwatching guides fill the shelves.

bulgarian: An expertly crafted clothing trunk. It smells like fresh pine!

bulgarian: A journal full of handwritten notes sits half open on the mantel.

bulgarian: "The Sister Kingdoms"

russian: Сценарии известных пьес и опер. Во всех из них одну из главных ролей исполняла Элси.
bulgarian: Scripts from famous plays and operas, all of which prominently feature a character played by Elsie.

english: A dazzling collection of clothing.
french: Éblouissante collection de vêtements.
russian: Блистательная коллекция одежды.
bulgarian: A dazzling collection of clothing.

english: There's also a survey section asking visitors to rate their experience.
french: Une enquête de satisfaction demande aux visiteurs d'évaluer leur expérience.
russian: Также там есть секция с опросом, в которой посетителей просят оценить свой визит.
bulgarian: There's also a survey section asking visitors to rate their experience.

english: Adeline's meeting schedule sits on the lectern outside her office along with a sign-in sheet...
french: Le planning de rendez-vous d'Adeline est posé sur le pupitre à l'extérieur de son bureau, avec une feuille d'émargement...
russian: На подставке возле офиса Аделины раскрыт её график приёма и лист для записи...
bulgarian: Adeline's meeting schedule sits on the lectern outside her office along with a sign-in sheet...

english: A fine example of early Aldarian pottery. It's a shame it's chipped.
french: Bel exemple de poterie primitive aldarienne. Dommage qu'elle soit ébréchée.
russian: Прекрасный образец раннеальдарийской керамики. Жаль, что край надломлен.
bulgarian: A fine example of early Aldarian pottery. It's a shame it's chipped.

english: An ancient stele depicting a set of legendary armor.
french: Ancienne stèle représentant les pièces d'une armure légendaire.
russian: Древняя стела с изображением набора легендарных доспехов.
bulgarian: An ancient stele depicting a set of legendary armor.

english: The door is boarded up.
french: La porte est barrée.
russian: Эта дверь заколочена.
bulgarian: The door is boarded up.

english: Rubble fills the doorway, blocking it completely.
french: Des gravats bouchent le passage, empêchant totalement l'accès.
russian: Дверной проход доверху завален обломками.
bulgarian: Rubble fills the doorway, blocking it completely.

english: The entrance to the $Mines$ appears to be boarded up...
french: L'entrée des mines a été condamnée avec des planches.
russian: Кажется, вход в шахты заколочен.
bulgarian: The entrance to the $Mines$ appears to be boarded up...

english: The doorway has been resealed after your and March's incident.
french: L'accès a été de nouveau condamné après l'incident vous impliquant, March et vous.
russian: После вашего с Мартом происшествия проход снова запечатали.
bulgarian: The doorway has been resealed after your and March's incident.

english: "Do not enter."
french: « Entrée interdite. »
russian: «Не входить».
bulgarian: "Do not enter."

english: "Do not enter."
french: « Entrée interdite. »
russian: «Не входить».
bulgarian: "Do not enter."

english: The stairs look too dangerous to climb in this state. They were probably destroyed in the earthquake.
french: Il est trop dangereux d'emprunter l'escalier dans son état actuel. Il a sans doute été détruit par le tremblement de terre.
russian: При нынешнем состоянии ступеней забираться по ним опасно. Вероятно, они обрушились от землетрясения.
bulgarian: The stairs look too dangerous to climb in this state. They were probably destroyed in the earthquake.

english: Rubble blocks what appears to be a cave entrance.
french: Des gravats obstruent ce qui ressemble à l'entrée d'une grotte.
russian: Видимо, это вход в пещеру, заваленный обломками.
bulgarian: Rubble blocks what appears to be a cave entrance.

english: An ancient stone gryphon. They seem to be a common feature in the Narrows.
french: Ancien griffon de pierre. Il n'est pas rare d'en trouver, sur les Terrasses.
russian: Древний каменный грифон. Кажется, они часто встречаются в ущелье.
bulgarian: An ancient stone gryphon. They seem to be a common feature in the Narrows.

english: ^"Her Highness has given her order."^
french: ^« Sa Majesté a parlé. »^
russian: ^«Её величество дала приказ».^
bulgarian: ^"Her Highness has given her order."^

english: ^"The $Dragon Forge$ shall remain burning, day and night."^
french: ^« La $forge-dragon$ doit fonctionner de jour comme de nuit, sans interruption. »^
russian: ^«$Драконья кузня$ должна пылать днём и ночью».^
bulgarian: ^"The $Dragon Forge$ shall remain burning, day and night."^

english: A scroll lays open on the ancient workbench...
french: Un parchemin est ouvert sur le vieil établi...
russian: На древнем рабочем столе лежит раскрытый свиток...
bulgarian: A scroll lays open on the ancient workbench...

english: ^"The sun and moon govern heaven and earth."^
french: ^« Le soleil et la lune régissent le firmament et la terre. »^
russian: ^«Солнце и луна правят на небесах и на земле».^
bulgarian: ^"The sun and moon govern heaven and earth."^

english: ^"Their lights shine down-"^
french: ^« Nous sommes baignés de leur lumière... »^
russian: ^«Их свет сияет нам...»^
bulgarian: ^"Their lights shine down-"^

english: ^"Yet I fear darkness is rising."^
french: ^« Or, je crains que les ténèbres ne grandissent. »^
russian: ^«Но я боюсь, что тьма растёт».^
bulgarian: ^"Yet I fear darkness is rising."^

english: An ornate scroll lays open on the crumbling workbench...
french: Un parchemin enluminé est ouvert sur l'établi en mauvais état...
russian: На осыпающемся рабочем столе лежит раскрытый свиток...
bulgarian: An ornate scroll lays open on the crumbling workbench...

english: The dragon-fire stove in its base was likely used for cooking and ambient warmth.
french: Le brasier en forme de dragon devait servir à cuisiner et à réchauffer la pièce.
russian: Плита с драконьим пламенем, вероятно, использовалась для готовки и обогрева помещения.
bulgarian: Печката с драконов огън в основата му вероятно е служила за готвене и за топлина.

english: An ancient stone bedstead.
french: C'est un ancien sommier en pierre.
russian: Древняя каменная кровать.
bulgarian: Древно каменно легло.

english: ^"His Lordship grows increasingly wary with the waxing of the moon."^
french: ^« La fatigue gagne de plus en plus Son Excellence à mesure que la lune entre dans sa phase croissante. »^
russian: ^«Его милость всё более обеспокоен растущей луной».^
bulgarian: ^„Негово благородие става все по-предпазлив с нарастването на луната.“^

english: ^"We must continue to perform the sacred rituals, despite events above ground."^
french: ^« Nous devons poursuivre les rituels sacrés malgré les événements qui se produisent à la surface. »^
russian: ^«Мы обязаны продолжать священные ритуалы, невзирая на события на поверхности».^
bulgarian: ^„Трябва да продължим да изпълняваме свещените ритуали въпреки събитията на повърхността.“^

english: ^"The flow of $Magic$ remains steady, for now."^
french: ^« Le flux de $magie$ demeure stable, pour l'instant. »^
russian: ^«Поток $магии$ пока стабилен».^
bulgarian: ^„Потокът на $магията$ засега остава стабилен.“^

english: ^"Yet I wonder..."^
french: ^« Pourtant, je ne peux pas m'empêcher de me poser la question... »^
russian: ^«Но я переживаю...»^
bulgarian: ^„Но се питам…“^

english: ^"Will we be able to weather the gathering storm?"^
french: ^« Parviendrons-nous à résister à la tempête qui s'annonce ? »^
russian: ^«Сможем ли мы выдержать надвигающаюся бурю?»^
bulgarian: ^„Ще успеем ли да устоим на задаващата се буря?“^

english: An ornate scroll lays open on the dusty shelf...
french: Un parchemin enluminé est ouvert sur l'étagère poussiéreuse...
russian: На пыльной полке лежит раскрытый свиток...
bulgarian: Украсен свитък лежи разгънат върху прашния рафт…

english: An ancient statue depicting a Dragon Priestess. They must have worshipped at this temple long ago.
french: Statue ancienne représentant une prêtresse dragon. Ce temple devait être un lieu de culte, il y a fort longtemps.
russian: Древняя статуя, изображающая жрицу дракона. Видимо, давным-давно это был их храм.
bulgarian: An ancient statue depicting a Dragon Priestess. They must have worshipped at this temple long ago.

english: The side of the sand castle is engraved with the name "Fort Dangerous II".
french: Sur le côté du château de sable est inscrit le nom « Fort Redoutable II ».
russian: На боку песочного замка написано название «Форт Опасный II».
bulgarian: The side of the sand castle is engraved with the name "Fort Dangerous II".

english: The shelves are piled high with scrolls and strange objects.
french: Les étagères sont remplies de parchemins et d'objets insolites.
russian: Эти полки доверху набиты свитками и непонятными предметами.
bulgarian: The shelves are piled high with scrolls and strange objects.

english: A mysterious fire burns. You might be able to use this for something later...
french: Un feu d'une nature mystérieuse brûle. Cela pourrait bien vous servir plus tard...
russian: Здесь горит мистический огонь. Возможно, он пригодится вам позже...
bulgarian: A mysterious fire burns. You might be able to use this for something later...

english: A planter full of spring flowers. They smell nice!
french: Un bac rempli de fleurs de printemps. Elles sentent bon !
russian: Клумба с весенними цветами. Они так приятно пахнут!
bulgarian: A planter full of spring flowers. They smell nice!

english: Freshly dried fish.
french: Poisson fraîchement séché.
russian: Свежезасушенная рыба.
bulgarian: Freshly dried fish.

english: A shelf of nautical trinkets.
french: Étagère remplie de petits objets en lien avec la mer.
russian: Шкаф с морскими безделушками.
bulgarian: A shelf of nautical trinkets.

english: A model of an impressively large fish.
french: Maquette d'un poisson de taille impressionnante.
russian: Макет необычайно большой рыбы.
bulgarian: A model of an impressively large fish.

english: The fountain adds a peaceful atmosphere to the upper town square.
french: La fontaine confère à la place principale une atmosphère apaisante.
russian: Фонтан придаёт верхней городской площади атмосферу спокойствия.
bulgarian: The fountain adds a peaceful atmosphere to the upper town square.
